- **Cercospora** (LeafNet_3464, 3948): Small/unclear spots, greenish irregular patches. Weak match.
- **Rust** (LeafNet_2157): Pale yellowish diffuse patches. No match.
- **Phoma** (LeafNet_165): Large necrotic edge lesion. No match.
- **Miner** (LeafNet_1145): Irregular brown blotch. No match.
- **Berry_Blotch** (PlantWild_107): **Strong match** — green coffee leaves with multiple discrete circular brown spots, very similar to the test image pattern.

The test image shows circular, dark-brown, discrete spots scattered on green coffee leaves. This matches Berry_Blotch (PlantWild_107) most closely among all references viewed.
